sections.content: Machine-learning and operational-analytics engagement for prioritizing clarification cases so analysts could focus effort on higher-value reviews and use capacity more effectively.
sections.title: Summary

sections.content:
Evidence supports:

- developing a PySpark-based analytical model for predicting/prioritizing false clarifications
- building an interactive MicroStrategy/reporting layer for analyst use
- collaborating with fraud-prevention specialists to incorporate domain expertise
- translating model outputs into operational prioritization rather than treating prediction as an isolated deliverable
- communicating performance and workflow implications to client stakeholders

The documented impact belongs to the project/team. Personal contribution is strongest for model/dashboard implementation and cross-functional analytical delivery.
